notes.title: New video game update!
notes.content:
¡Greetings, players! We are pleased to announce the arrival of a new update to our beloved video game. On this occasion, we have focused on improving the gaming experience and fixing some issues that were reported to us. We hope that these improvements allow you to enjoy the game even more and provide you with a smoother and more satisfying experience. Below, we present the patch notes with the improvements we have made. Let's play!

[list]
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[*] Added the ability to adjust music volume.
[*] Improved readability of the game invitation screen.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]
